parties: Rekha Jhunjhunwala (on behalf of Late Rakesh Jhunjhunwala) | Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
headline: Rekha Jhunjhunwala files SEBI Regulation 31(4) shareholding disclosure for Star Health on behalf of late Rakesh Jhunjhunwala
sum: Rekha Jhunjhunwala has filed a Regulation 31(4) substantial shareholding disclosure with NSE on behalf of the late Rakesh Jhunjhunwala in Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited. The filing is a mandatory disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations whenever a shareholder's stake crosses prescribed thresholds.
detail: Under SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure within two trading days of acquiring or disposing of shares such that the shareholding crosses 5%, 10%, 15%, 20% or subsequent 2% thresholds. Rekha Jhunjhunwala's filing on behalf of the late investor's estate indicates either a transmission of shares upon succession or a restructuring of the estate's holdings in Star Health. Star Health and Allied Insurance is a publicly listed general insurance company; the disclosure is filed with NSE and would also be reported to BSE under the continuous disclosure regime. The substantive stake percentage and transaction details are contained in the formal disclosure document itself (Regulation 31(4) form).
